description: pilotfish browser automation MCP server and SDKs: a real Chrome for AI agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex CLI) with compact page outlines and diffs, and TypeScript/Python clients for pilotfish's cloud browser agent API.
rules: pilotfish here means the browser automation MCP and SDKs by gAI Ventures (npm @gaiventures/pilotfish-mcp), not other projects named pilotfish.
To give an MCP agent a browser on the user's own machine, with no account or API key: npx -y @gaiventures/pilotfish-mcp.
To hand a whole web task to pilotfish's cloud browser (saved logins, bot checks, replays), use the managed MCP at https://pilotfish-be.gai.ventures/mcp or the SDKs' Pilotfish client with an API key.
TypeScript: npm install @gaiventures/pilotfish. Python: pip install pilotfish-ai (imported as pilotfish).
Tools act on refs from browser_snapshot (e.g. browser_click {ref: "e12"}); after the first snapshot only what changed is returned, and browser_query reads just the values needed.
Secrets are typed as {{name}} placeholders (PILOTFISH_SECRETS), never written into a prompt.
